# Start Here

FLEX is FL Studio's modern, production-ready hybrid synthesizer with 500GB+ of curated content.

## Quick Overview
- **Type**: Hybrid preset-based synthesizer
- **Engines**: Subtractive, FM, Wavetable, Sampler hybrids
- **Strength**: Production-ready sounds with macro control

## First Steps
1. Load a preset from the browser
2. Use Macro 1 (Tone) to shape brightness
3. Adjust attack/decay for your genre
4. Add subtle reverb for space

## Golden Rules
- Start with presets, tweak macros
- Use the limiter for density
- Layer sounds, not parameters

learning.title: FLEX vs Others
learning.source:
# FLEX vs Other Synths

FLEX focuses on **production-ready sounds** rather than deep synthesis.

| Feature | FLEX | Serum | Vital |
|---------|------|-------|-------|
| CPU | Low | Medium | Medium |
| Presets | 500GB+ | ~100 | ~200 |
| Learning Curve | Easy | Hard | Medium |

# FLEX Quick Reference

## Macros
- **Macro 1**: Usually Tone/Brightness
- **Macro 2**: Usually Character/Movement

## Master Section
- **Attack/Decay**: Shape transients
- **Width**: Stereo spread
- **Limiter**: Add density/loudness

reference.title: Parameter Cheat Sheet
reference.source:
# Parameter Cheat Sheet

| Control | Purpose | Tip |
|---------|---------|-----|
| Macro 1 | Tone | Automate for movement |
| Macro 2 | Character | Use sparingly |
| Attack | Transient | Low for plucks |

reference.title: Synthesis Engine
reference.source:
# Synthesis Engines

FLEX uses hybrid synthesis combining:
- Subtractive (filters)
- FM (frequency modulation)
- Wavetable (morphing waves)
- Sampler (multisampled content)
